paragraphs.text:
The sounds and smells of your group defeat any attempt to stalk 
game, but you find prints in the clay that suggest a large feline 
predator. You leave Norman and Sylvia at the foot of a rocky 
hill and take Bernard on the hunt. You can tell he is suppressing 
a boyish excitement.

You track your prey for an hour, hoping for a major kill. Make a 
Listen roll: if you succeed, go to 611; if you fail, go to 615.
